page_notes.381: Expanded PVC Panels (5-15): 4 F/M-badged panel rows (2615, 2617, 2618, 2623) extracted; metric 65- equivalents recorded in notes; Standard Machining Services table (Cut-to-Size 11-25, Drill Thru 11-46) has no service numbers or 15 badge, so recorded as notes only.
page_notes.382: Aluminum Composite Panels (5-16): F row 2650 extracted; separate metric-only row 65-2650 skipped (summarized in notes).
page_notes.383: Lite Aluminum Composite Panels (5-17): 3 F/M-badged rows (2633, 2635, 2637) extracted with merged material/thickness/sheet size/weight cells applied to all rows.
page_notes.385: Twin Wall Polycarbonate Panels (5-19): F row 2640 extracted; metric-only row 65-2640 skipped; channel-orientation footnote (see page 5-7) kept in notes.
page_notes.386: HDPE Pegboard (2659, 2664; F/M) and Single-Sided Whiteboard (2681; F only) extracted (5-20); single machining table at bottom of page with note that edge radius machining is not available for the whiteboard.
page_notes.387: UHMW-ESD Panels (2627, 2626) and Cross Linked Protective Foam (CF-4618-4LBS, CF-4634-4LBS), all F/M-badged, extracted (5-21).
page_notes.388: Phenolic Resin Panel (2808, 2814, 2815) and Laminated Tabletop (2800, 2802, 2804, 2806), all F/M-badged, extracted (5-22); machining table lists Cut-to-Size only.

remaining_doubts: Standard Machining Services tables on every page (Cut-to-Size 11-25, Drill Thru 11-46; p388 Cut-to-Size only) have no service numbers and no series badge, so no machining_service parts were created; references kept in notes.

p386: the note 'Edge radius machining not available for this panel' sits under the single machining table below the Single-Sided Whiteboard; it is attributed to 2681 only, but the page layout does not make clear whether it also covers the pegboard (2659, 2664).
p387 CF-4618-4LBS / CF-4634-4LBS: weight is printed as plain lb with UoM EA; reading it as weight per 48” x 96” sheet is an inference.
p388 2814/2815: Color 'Black' is one merged cell covering all three phenolic rows (confirmed in the image) even though the finishes are woodgrain; kept as printed.
